why: `_sacredWindowNullOverride`, `_stubTrack`, `_navigateTo` (plus `_incomingGrantsEmpty(Override)`, `_pendingInvitesEmpty(Override)`, `_connectivityOnline(Override)`, `_dashboardActiveTracksOverrides`, `_activeTracksOneShotOverride`, `_pendingRedemptionsOneShotOverride`) are diff-verified byte-identical private top-level functions copy-pasted across 8 of this batch's 10 files, instead of living once in e2e_harness.dart — which already has exactly this precedent (`dashboardSilenceOverrides` is a shared harness getter). Copy-paste has already drifted: the identical one-line connectivity-online body is named `_connectivityOnlineOverride` in two files and `_connectivityOnline` in a third; `_incomingGrantsEmptyOverride` vs `_incomingGrantsEmpty`. If any underlying provider signature changes, all 8 files need the same hand-fix — shotgun surgery, and the naming drift shows nobody is doing that consistently today.
recommendation: Move the duplicated helpers onto E2EHarness (matching the existing dashboardSilenceOverrides pattern) or into a new test/e2e/harness/e2e_common_overrides.dart, and have all 8 files import rather than redefine them.
acceptance_criteria: One canonical definition each for the sacred-window/tutor-grant/connectivity/track-stub/navigate-to helpers, imported by the 8 affected files instead of redefined
No byte-identical private top-level function bodies remain duplicated across test/e2e/journeys/*.dart for these symbols

corrections: Only 3 of the ~9 parenthetically-named duplicated helpers carry explicit evidence citations; the rest (_activeTracksOneShotOverride etc.) are asserted, not cited — spot-checked one (gamification_p0/p1_test.dart) and it does duplicate, so the broader claim holds, but evidence array is thinner than the prose implies.
